title: Louis C.K. Hates Cell Phones | CONAN on TBS
summary: Louis C.K. on Conan explains why he won't give his kids cell phones. He argues that phones keep people from sitting with sadness and being alone with their thoughts, and that kids lose empathy when they cannot see another person's reaction.
why: Commenters bring it up in threads on phones, boredom, attention and children's screen use as a funny but resonant take.

quote.text: arrived at the same conclusion much more concisely nearly a decade ago
